'''Ammonites''' are [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] cephalopods from the [[wikipedia:CRETACEOUS|Cretaceous]] era. They can be found in any type of [[savage]] ocean. Like standard fish, they can be butchered (and will give a shell, but no bones) and are immobile on land, but unlike standard fish, they will never feel dizzy and never sleep.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] ammonites for their ''shells'' and ''many tentacles''.
